title: How governance research turns model uncertainty into institutional design
titleZh: 治理研究如何把模型不确定性转化为制度设计
question: What changes when AI risk is treated as a coordination problem rather than only a model-quality problem?
questionZh: 当 AI 风险被视为协同治理问题，而不只是模型质量问题时，产品设计会发生什么变化？
method: Conceptual synthesis across AI governance, institutional accountability, and model evaluation literature.
methodZh: 综合 AI 治理、制度问责和模型评测相关文献的概念性分析。
finding: The useful product boundary is a handoff between model evidence, accountable actors, and an operational decision. A digest should preserve all three layers instead of flattening them into a confidence score.
findingZh: 有价值的产品边界，是把模型证据、责任主体和实际决策连接起来。研究简报不应把三者压扁成一个置信度分数。
limitation: This is a structured editorial demo based on public metadata; it is not a systematic review.
limitationZh: 这是基于公开元数据的编辑演示，不是系统性综述。
takeaways: Separate evidence from the operational decision.
Treat uncertainty as a product field.

title: A reading workflow for platform power and generative AI
titleZh: 平台权力与生成式 AI 的研究阅读工作流
question: Which parts of a fast-moving platform politics paper should a researcher verify first?
questionZh: 面对快速变化的平台政治论文，研究者应该优先核验哪些部分？
method: A workflow experiment that separates claim extraction, evidence tracing, and transfer-to-case notes.
methodZh: 将论断提取、证据追踪和案例迁移笔记分开的工作流实验。
finding: Separating claims from evidence makes it easier to spot where a digest is summarising an argument versus making a new inference. That distinction becomes a quality check, not a disclaimer added at the end.
findingZh: 把论断和证据分开，可以更容易判断简报是在复述作者观点，还是在做新的推断。这种区分应成为质量检查的一部分，而不是最后补上的免责声明。
limitation: The example is a workflow demonstration and does not estimate a population-level effect.
limitationZh: 该案例用于展示工作流，不估计总体层面的影响。
takeaways: Keep author claims and editor synthesis apart.
Record transfer conditions before comparing cases.

title: Why a research agent needs a quality gate between reading and publishing
titleZh: 为什么研究型 Agent 需要在精读与发布之间设置质量闸门
question: Where should a paper-digest workflow slow down to protect source fidelity?
questionZh: 论文摘编工作流应在哪个环节主动放慢，以保护来源忠实度？
method: Product workflow analysis of retrieval, extraction, rewrite, review, and distribution handoffs.
methodZh: 对检索、提取、改写、审核和分发交接点的产品工作流分析。
finding: A quality gate is most valuable at the handoff from generated prose to public content. It should surface unsupported claims, missing citations, and a clear distinction between author findings and editor interpretation.
findingZh: 质量闸门在从生成文本交接到公开内容的节点最有价值。它应主动暴露无来源论断、缺失引用，并区分作者发现和编辑解读。
limitation: The workflow is a local MVP; model-level reliability still needs a blind human evaluation round.
limitationZh: 该工作流是本地 MVP，模型层面的可靠性仍需通过人工双盲评测验证。
takeaways: Block distribution when provenance is missing.

title: A practical stack for literature review without losing provenance
titleZh: 不牺牲来源可追溯性的文献综述工具栈
question: Which tool handoffs reduce repeated reading work while keeping citations inspectable?
questionZh: 哪些工具交接能减少重复阅读，同时保持引用可核验？
method: Workflow mapping across discovery, reference management, extraction, and human review.
methodZh: 对发现、文献管理、信息提取和人工审核环节的工作流映射。
finding: The highest-leverage boundary is not a single tool. It is a shared evidence object that travels from discovery to the final brief with a source URL and an uncertainty note.
findingZh: 最有杠杆的边界不是某一个工具，而是一个从发现阶段一路带到最终简报的证据对象，其中包含来源链接和不确定性说明。
limitation: This is a product workflow comparison; tool capabilities and pricing change over time.
limitationZh: 这是产品工作流比较，工具能力和价格会随时间变化。
takeaways: Choose a handoff contract before choosing tools.

title: From model card to accountable product handoff
titleZh: 从模型卡片到可问责的产品交接
question: What information must survive when an evaluation result enters a product decision?
questionZh: 当评测结果进入产品决策时，哪些信息必须被保留下来？
method: Conceptual design review of evidence, ownership, and escalation fields.
methodZh: 对证据、责任归属和升级字段的概念性产品评审。
finding: A score without scope, owner, and escalation path is hard to act on. The product handoff should preserve the tested population, known failure cases, and who can pause distribution.
findingZh: 没有适用范围、负责人和升级路径的分数很难转化为行动。产品交接应保留测试人群、已知失败案例，以及谁有权暂停分发。
limitation: The fields are a design proposal, not a legal compliance checklist.
limitationZh: 这些字段是设计提案，不是法律合规清单。

title: How to compare AI claims across international relations cases
titleZh: 如何比较国际关系案例中的 AI 论断
question: Which contextual variables should a digest preserve before transferring an AI governance claim across countries?
questionZh: 把 AI 治理论断迁移到不同国家前，简报应该保留哪些背景变量？
method: Comparative reading template for actors, institutions, incentives, and evidence boundaries.
methodZh: 围绕主体、制度、激励和证据边界的比较阅读模板。
finding: Comparisons become more useful when the digest states what is held constant and what is not. A shared label such as governance capacity cannot replace the local institutional mechanism.
findingZh: 当简报明确哪些变量保持不变、哪些变量不同，比较才更有价值。“治理能力”这样的共同标签不能替代当地制度机制。
limitation: No country-level causal inference is made from this editorial template.
limitationZh: 该编辑模板不做国家层面的因果推断。

title: Bilingual parity is a quality dimension, not a translation afterthought
titleZh: 双语一致性是质量维度，而不是翻译收尾工作
question: How can a bilingual brief preserve uncertainty and scope rather than only the headline meaning?
questionZh: 双语简报如何保留不确定性和适用范围，而不只是翻译标题意思？
method: Rubric design exercise with parity checks for claims, qualifiers, and limitations.
methodZh: 针对论断、限定语和局限性设计双语一致性 rubric。
finding: Parity failures often happen in qualifiers: may becomes will, a sample becomes a population, or an editorial interpretation becomes an author claim. The quality gate should inspect those transitions.
findingZh: 双语偏差经常发生在限定语上：may 被写成 will，样本被写成总体，编辑解读被写成作者论断。质量闸门需要检查这些变化。
limitation: The examples are synthetic and need blind bilingual annotation.
limitationZh: 示例为合成数据，仍需人工双盲双语标注。

title: A map for reading platform power without flattening institutions
titleZh: 阅读平台权力时，如何避免把制度压平
question: How should a researcher separate platform affordances from institutional power?
questionZh: 研究者应如何区分平台可供性与制度权力？
method: Concept map separating infrastructure, governance actors, incentives, and user practices.
methodZh: 区分基础设施、治理主体、激励和用户实践的概念图。
finding: A product-oriented digest can make institutional actors first-class fields. This prevents the platform interface from becoming the only explanation for political outcomes.
findingZh: 产品化简报可以把制度主体设置为一等字段，避免把平台界面当成政治结果的唯一解释。
limitation: The map is an editorial aid and not a theory test.
limitationZh: 该地图是编辑辅助工具，不是理论检验。
takeaways: Do not infer politics from UI alone.

title: The smallest provenance field that changes an editorial workflow
titleZh: 一个最小来源字段如何改变编辑工作流
question: What should an editor record when a source is only partially available?
questionZh: 当只能获得部分来源时，编辑应该记录什么？
method: Schema design for source status, retrieval date, evidence quote, and review owner.
methodZh: 为来源状态、检索日期、证据摘录和审核负责人设计字段。
finding: A source-status field creates a useful pause: verified full text, public abstract, metadata only, or user-provided excerpt. Each state implies a different publishing boundary.
findingZh: 来源状态字段可以制造一个有价值的停顿：已核验全文、公开摘要、仅元数据或用户提供的摘录。每种状态都对应不同的发布边界。
limitation: The schema does not guarantee that a cited source supports every claim.
limitationZh: 这个 schema 不能保证引用来源支持每一个论断。
takeaways: Require a review owner for exceptions.

title: Designing an evidence object that can survive tool changes
titleZh: 设计一个能跨工具变化持续存在的证据对象
question: Which fields should remain stable when retrieval and generation providers change?
questionZh: 当检索和生成服务商变化时，哪些字段应该保持稳定？
method: Product contract exercise for source, claim, quote, uncertainty, and editor decision fields.
methodZh: 围绕来源、论断、摘录、不确定性和编辑决策字段的产品契约练习。
finding: Stable evidence fields make provider changes observable. They also let EvalKit compare outputs without treating a model name as a quality guarantee.
findingZh: 稳定的证据字段让服务商切换可被观察，也让 EvalKit 能够比较输出，而不是把模型名称当成质量保证。
limitation: The contract still needs a real corpus and licensing review.
limitationZh: 该契约仍需真实语料和版权审查。
takeaways: Log provider changes separately from quality changes.

title: A review queue for claims that cross regional policy boundaries
titleZh: 面向跨地区政策边界论断的审核队列
question: How can an editorial team route the same AI claim to different regional reviewers?
questionZh: 编辑团队如何把同一条 AI 论断分发给不同地区审核者？
method: Scenario-subject-tool matrix combined with region, evidence, and escalation metadata.
methodZh: 将场景—主体—工具矩阵与地区、证据和升级元数据结合。
finding: The queue should preserve the original copy, evidence, region, and reviewer decision separately. A single global approval hides meaningful differences in advertising and privacy rules.
findingZh: 队列应分别保留原始文案、证据、地区和审核决定。单一的全球批准会掩盖广告和隐私规则的实际差异。
limitation: This is a product proposal; regional legal advice remains out of scope.
limitationZh: 这是产品提案，地区法律意见不在范围内。

title: Where human review adds the most value in a research pipeline
titleZh: 研究流水线中人工审核最有价值的节点
question: Which handoffs should stay human-owned when a digest pipeline becomes automated?
questionZh: 当论文简报流水线自动化后，哪些交接仍应由人负责？
method: Risk-weighted workflow design using source availability, claim specificity, and audience impact.
methodZh: 基于来源可得性、论断具体性和受众影响的风险加权工作流设计。
finding: Human review is most valuable when a claim is specific, a source is partial, or the audience may act on the brief. Automation can prepare evidence; it should not silently decide publication.
findingZh: 当论断具体、来源不完整或受众可能据此行动时，人工审核最有价值。自动化可以准备证据，但不应静默决定发布。
limitation: The prioritization needs observed review time and error data.
limitationZh: 该优先级仍需真实审核时长和错误数据验证。
takeaways: Use risk to allocate review time.
